== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-roguebantha-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Rogue Bantha]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Rogue Bantha (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “carry” becomes “add”; “passengers.” becomes “'riders' (passengers).”; “½.” becomes “1/2.”; “At start of” becomes “Whenever a”; “was just initiated” is added after “start of battle”; “exterior” is dropped. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Rogue Bantha” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
